$comment: C11/C23 6.7.11 + 6.6 ([[D-C-STATIC-ASSERT-REFUSES-A-LONG-DOUBLE-COMPARISON]]): a floating-point comparison folds to a constant in EVERY integer-constant-expression position — static assertion, enumerator, bit-field width and array bound. ✔MEASURED separately on gcc 13.3.0, clang 18.1.3, mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 and MSVC 19.51: all four accept this file, and DSS refused it before this example existed. The EXIT CODE is the instrument, not the assertions: the array bound and the enumerator are computed from the same comparisons, so a fold that answered the wrong truth value would still compile and would exit with a number other than 42.
